Plain paths are still written joined by ', ', so the exact-match assertions at launch_test.go:345 and engine/cmd/review_launch_test.go:202 stay valid.

Candidate.Paths comes from git diff-tree -r --name-only -z --no-renames (gitexec.go:167) through splitPaths, raw, so a path is never quoted twice and a raw newline or control byte does reach changedPaths.

A newline, CR, tab, other control byte, invalid UTF-8 byte or a non-printable rune makes strconv.Quote differ, so the path is quoted; a backslash or a double quote is quoted too; a path holding ', ' is quoted; leading or trailing spaces stay plain; a backtick cannot open a fence because the line starts with 'changed paths: '; an empty list writes 'changed paths: ' as before.
README.md:791 and engine/cmd/usage.go:246 were updated; bin/lib/usage.sh:358 does not describe the format.
